test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'COUCH' is coded as FLXZK and 'TABLE' is coded as WXEIH. How will 'CHAIR' be coded in the same language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic here follows is:

The word 'COUCH' is coded as 'FLXZK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/335d494997277d2755522ec37b30af579e585642bc8aacc710c9daacf43902fb.png] 

In the same way, 'TABLE' is coded as 'WXEIH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c721bc7cf36e17b541ea6df5fb2336094f35a50c76d6bb8763a98d13bb400b3f.png] 

Similarly, '**CHAIR**' will be coded as '**FEDFU**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de18f98021833197de8178641f6074650df119ebbaac1f33a826cc0b7c71756d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is '**FEDFU**'
